# arnaud-zg/skills

> A Claude Code plugin marketplace named arnaud-zg-skills: Agent Skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers,
> each linted, tested and versioned. Its first plugin, arnaud-zg, ships the skills listed in its README.

- [Documentation home](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/docs/README.md): a map of every page

## Skills

- [arnaud-zg plugin README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/README.md): every skill, what it does, how to call it, and links to its tutorial, how-to guides, reference, explanation and SKILL.md
- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/skills`
- Install in any agent: `npx skills add arnaud-zg/skills --skill <name>`

## Writing a Claude Code plugin in this repository
